blocker: Partial Accra Metro app geometry sample exists, but the request had no spatial filter and the sample lies about 8 km south of the WUP center. Citywide coverage, source completeness, stable parcel-ID semantics and snapshot adapter readiness remain unproven.
remainingUncertainty: A failed, absent, or unavailable query does not establish that the city has no cadastral data; authenticated, offline, non-indexed or locally hosted records may exist.
nextStep: Find a safe spatially bounded endpoint or a filterable local-area query near Accra, then assess native identifier semantics, source completeness and adapter readiness.

requests.assessment: The app JS sends tbl=parcel&flds=* and accepts an optional where. A Range bytes=0-32767 request with a 32768-byte client cap returned a prefix; Range was ignored. Exactly three complete features parsed and saved with parcelid, parcelcode and geometry only; no spatial filter was applied.
